intro: Cashew nuts are the backbone of Guinea-Bissau's economy.

chapters.title: Cashews
text: Cashews make up most exports, mostly sold to India for processing. Rice and fishing are also important.

chapters.title: Poverty
text: It is one of the poorest countries in the world.

cardGroups.title: Made in Guinea-Bissau
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Guinea-Bissau makes and sells to the world.
